correctness.rationale: Direct exact identities give \(\dot U=zBU\) and \(\dot H=2zBH\). U is the first-order transverse coordinate on the torus at \(z=\pm1\). The source angular formula reduces to \(-\omega-aA_s\cdot n\), whose complete rotation criterion and original-time integral yield \(T_s=2\pi/\Delta_s\). Integrating the torus-transverse variational equation with the elementary vector first-harmonic integral yields \(\log(\mu_s)\) exactly; the two algebraic control identities follow by expansion. Boundaries \(\Delta_s^2\le0\) have angular equilibria. The checker reproduces exact algebra and eight independent numerical quadratures; finite tests are supplementary.

value.rationale: This is an exact, complete period-and-Floquet classification for the two naturally distinguished invariant parallels in the minimal affine-angular nontrivial subclass of a published cubic torus system. The return period and hyperbolic orientation are controlled by independent determinant and dot product coordinates, giving equal-time opposite-stability and unequal-time neutral examples. This is a motivated structural consequence of the system, not an arbitrary finite sample, a renamed existence test, or a routine parameter substitution.
